mechanism: Sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) combined with clonidine (alpha-2 agonist) increases hypotensive risk through additive vasodilation and sympatholytic effects, with potential for rebound hypertension if clonidine is abruptly discontinued.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely; consider alternative antihypertensive agent or use reduced clonidine doses with careful titration; avoid abrupt clonidine discontinuation due to rebound hypertension risk.
